content: Lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate are combined in a vaginal formulation indicated for the prevention of pregnancy in females of reproductive potential. This product is designed to be used as an on-demand contraceptive method. A single prefilled applicator containing 5 grams of the product should be applied vaginally either immediately before or up to one hour prior to each act of vaginal intercourse. If more than one act of vaginal intercourse occurs within the same hour, an additional dose must be applied. Each 5-gram dose contains 90 mg of lactic acid, 50 mg of citric acid, and 20 mg of potassium bitartrate. The safety and efficacy of this product have not been fully established. However, it is expected to have similar efficacy in postmenarcheal females under 17 years of age as in those aged 17 years and older. This product is not indicated for use before menarche. If hypersensitivity reactions occur, the product should be discontinued immediately. It should not be used during pregnancy, and its use should be discontinued if pregnancy occurs. There is no available data on the use of this product in pregnant females or animals, nor is there information on the presence of its components or their metabolites in human breast milk, or their effects on breastfeeding or milk production. The mechanism of action involves lowering the vaginal pH, which is typically increased (above 6) following the introduction of semen due to its alkalinity. This neutralization of the normally acidic vaginal environment allows sperm to survive. The acidic components of this product reduce sperm motility by maintaining a low vaginal pH, thereby contributing to its contraceptive effect. This product may be used at any point during the menstrual cycle and can be initiated as soon as it is safe to resume vaginal intercourse after childbirth, abortion, or miscarriage. It should be stored in its original foil packaging at room temperature (20–25°C or 68–77°F), with permissible temperature excursions between 15–30°C (59–86°F). The information provided here is intended for general informational and educational purposes only. Formulary status and coverage may vary by individual plans, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most current information, contact the applicable plan provider.
